name: mirage
text: Version 1.0.78 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.78 . It's for diagnosis, not a fix for the misses. Install it. After your next failed bets, the report will show each miss with its price and how long Novig took to end the order. It also stops your phone asking GitHub for a bids file that doesn't exist.
